briefdescription.para: Handlers identifiers to obtain lua_Cfunction reference from Lua registry table.

detaileddescription.para: These handlers are initialized on Tarantool startup and are used until the Lua universe is destroyed. Such approach reduces Lua GC usage since there is no need to create short-lived GCfunc objects for the corresponding C function on each iproto CALL/EVAL request or stored Lua procedure call.
